summary.coverage_counterexample_if_only_exchange: Let S be one shared equiprobable sign in {-1,+1} and U_i be independent Uniform(0,2), i=1..6; set X_i = S*U_i. Each marginal is continuous Uniform(-2,2) with unique median 0 and the sample is exchangeable, yet all X_i share the sign of S, so the min-max interval NEVER contains 0. Coverage is 0, not 31/32.
summary.coverage_is_pointwise_not_simultaneous: Each group's interval is pointwise. No simultaneous or family-wise coverage over the 90 endpoint groups is claimed or implied.
summary.coverage_sufficient_assumption: POINTWISE coverage of the median for ONE arm. Sufficient assumption: six IID continuous observations, giving P(all above m)=P(all below m)=(1/2)^6 and hence 1-2(1/2)^6 = 31/32. A conditional construction also suffices ONLY if the observations are independent GIVEN the latent parameter AND every conditional law is continuous with the SAME median. Exchangeability with continuous marginals is NOT sufficient (see COVERAGE_COUNTEREXAMPLE). Six fresh processes do not establish IID. This is pointwise for a single arm and is NOT simultaneous coverage over the 90 endpoint groups.

Sufficient assumption: six IID continuous observations, giving P(all above m)=P(all below m)=(1/2)^6 and hence 1-2(1/2)^6 = 31/32. A conditional construction also suffices ONLY if the observations are independent GIVEN the latent parameter AND every conditional law is continuous with the SAME median. Exchangeability with continuous marginals is NOT sufficient (see COVERAGE_COUNTEREXAMPLE). Six fresh processes do not establish IID. This is pointwise for a single arm and is NOT simultaneous coverage over the 90 endpoint groups.

energy_total_j.coverage_counterexample_if_only_exchange: Let S be one shared equiprobable sign in {-1,+1} and U_i be independent Uniform(0,2), i=1..6; set X_i = S*U_i. Each marginal is continuous Uniform(-2,2) with unique median 0 and the sample is exchangeable, yet all X_i share the sign of S, so the min-max interval NEVER contains 0. Coverage is 0, not 31/32.
